infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice requests are spoken to the app.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Telly uses your location to notice when you go out and to show the family members you chose where you are.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Telly uses your location in the background to notice when you go out and come back, and tells only the family members you chose.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Telly uses your location in the background to notice when you go out and come back, and tells only the family members you chose.
